stories.title: Health board says there are “no quick or easy solutions” to Wrexham Maelor parking
stories.summary: Parking at Wrexham Maelor Hospital has reached “crisis point and is no longer sustainable”, according to Wrexham Council’s deputy leader. Cllr David A Bithell has asked council officers to look at extra land and park-and-ride options to ease pressure on the hospital site. stories.title: Man jailed for three years after driving stolen taxi the wrong way on the A55
stories.summary: A man who stole a taxi in Holyhead, seriously injured a cyclist and then drove the wrong way along the A55 has been jailed for three years.
